headline: Off-limits and personal-side senders stay off the Inbox's Filtered list and out of the mail rules. A draft's subject is checked as a title, so a held person's everyday-word last name is caught there. The voice list stays inside its size limit however many people are held. A typed to-do saves at once, and Week labels each column by its date. New under Settings: Connectors, starting with the calendar. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
